name: Soomaa
description: Raised bog and floodplain forest where the spring melt regularly puts the roads and gardens under a metre of water. Estonians call it the fifth season and deal with it by getting the canoe out. The rest of the year it's boardwalks over open bog.
getting: An hour from Pärnu or Viljandi by car. Flood season is usually late March to April and local operators run canoe trips through the trees.
